d:
Chhath mahaparv aate hi log dil se khud-ba-khud gungunane lagte hain. dil se nikla bhav juban par aate hi loggit ka rup le leta hai. jyadatar chhath ke aise git hain jo lok paranpra se ek dusre ke jarie pirhi-dar pirhi gae jate rahe hain. in giton ko likhne vala kaun hai, uske bare men koee jankari nahin. aise hi lok giton ko mashhur sangitkaron ne sharda sinha, anuradha paudval, alka aagyanik, jaise gayikaon ki surili aavaj men pirokar ise jan-jan tak pahuncha diya.
